name: Spout Layout Dual View
description: Layout locally, full GD frame over Spout2.

enabled.name: Enable dual view
enabled.description: Send the normal decorated frame to Spout and display Layout Mode locally while a PlayLayer is active.

sender-name.name: Spout sender name
sender-name.description: Name shown in OBS Spout2 Capture.

invert-spout.name: Invert Spout texture
invert-spout.description: OpenGL framebuffers are normally inverted for Spout receivers.

layout-player-view.name: Layout on game window
layout-player-view.description: If disabled, Spout still sends the full frame but the game window remains decorated.

mirror-simulation.name: Simulate layout mirror
mirror-simulation.description: Runs the stripped Layout Mode PlayLayer in lockstep for move/rotate/gameplay triggers. Recommended for XDBot-equivalent visuals.
